summary: Re-tested live dashboard/reports APIs and Expo preview at 390x844. Municipal Overview, Priority queue, Teams, citizen composer category/description/cancel flows all passed.
action_items: Keep frontend and deployment environment variable naming consistent: source currently uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the project testing contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; verify production Expo configuration preserves the currently working key.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API constant reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the specified EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; live preview works because frontend/.env currently defines EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, but this is a deployment/configuration risk.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ hazardous-waste report through the API; it was not deleted because the API has no DELETE endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo preview loaded without fatal/red-screen errors at 390x844. Staff tabs rendered distinct content. Citizen composer controls worked. API POST returned derived category/severity/volume/action fields; PATCH Resolved persisted verified_at and assignment.
rca_of_issue: Initial pytest attempt failed only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL was not exported in the shell, not because the API failed. Re-running with the value from frontend/.env passed both tests. No mocked APIs used.
